name: 30385-transcription-whisperturbo-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: WhisperForConditionalGeneration, encoder-decoder, float16, 808,878,080 params (~1.6 GB): 32 encoder layers / 4 decoder layers, d_model 1280, 20 heads, ffn 5120, 128 mel bins, max_source_positions 1500, max_target_positions 448, vocab 51866.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=2, warmup the first 20% by completion, max_requests 1460, safety cap 1800 s -- 1168 requests in the measured window. A LIGHTLY loaded transcription service, not a saturated one: this objective is p95 latency first.
workload: English speech transcription: one 16 kHz mono clip per request at its natural length (73 clips, mean 6.59 s, p50 5.60 s, max 29.40 s, all 16 kHz mono), no text prompt beyond the decoder control tokens `<|startoftranscript|><|en|><|transcribe|><|notimestamps|>`, greedy (temperature 0.0). Every reply is pinned to exactly 24 generated tokens (`min_tokens` = `max_tokens` = 24, the mean transcript length of this clip set), so every request does identical work and no reply can end early. The pool is the 73 clips of `hf-internal-testing/librispeech_asr_dummy` `clean`/`validation`, cycled 20 times.
purpose: An English speech-to-text service transcribing short audio clips two at a time on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for commit c0a350ca73fa8f10bd718fdcec47b075dc1d102f
# (v0.14.0rc1-143-gc0a350ca73). An unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not
# add keys from a later vLLM. The load is not in this file -- it is scenario.json's `streams`.
model: openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
